title: Selecting and Testing Asset Pricing Models: A Stepwise Approach Management Science forthcoming
hypothesis: H0: alpha_tilde(M)=0 spanning efficient model vs H1 alpha!=0; Efficient model defined SR2{F(M)} = SR2{F,R} no improvement; Optimal smallest efficient |T|=O(N^{n1})
data_sources: Author websites FF factors, REG, S_PLS investor sentiment Huang et al 2015
sample: Monthly U.S. equity returns January 1973 to December 2021. Universe: CRSP/Compustat. Candidate factors: 97 traded factors (23 popular +74 from Hou et al 2020 HXZ one-month holding) listed in Table factor_zoo with Avg.Ret% and Ann.SR%. Baseline factor models (7): CAPM (MKT), FF3 (MKT SMB HML), FF5 (FF3 + RMW CMA), FF6 (FF5 + UMD), Q5 (MKT SMB IA ROE REG), DHS3 (MKT PEAD FIN), BS6 (MKT SMB UMD ROE IA HMLM). Test assets for pricing: 285 bivariate-sorted basis portfolios (25 size/BM, 25 size/OP, 25 size/INV, 25 size/MOM, 25 size/beta, 25 size/STR, 25 size/LTR, 25 size/var, 25 size/resid var, 35 size/NSI, 25 size/accruals) from Ken French + unselected candidate factors as LHS test assets. LHS = F_tilde(M) = F \\ M. RHS = F_M. Optional additional test assets R_t (basis portfolios) plus unselected factors. Filters: 97 factors must have full history 1973-2021; 74 HXZ factors one-month holding; sentiment S_PLS constructed from regression on past 36m returns. Simulation DGP: f1 ~ N(mu1,Sigma1) calibrated to real data K1=5 FF5; f2 = beta' f1 + u, u~N(0,Sigma2). Sample sizes: T=588 months total; N=97 LHS varying N-|M|; T=3000/600 in simulation with K2=20/100.
method: 1. Data: Collect monthly returns for 97 candidate factors Ft (N=97) and 285 basis portfolios Rt from Jan 1973-Dec 2021 (T=588). Compute means mu_x and covariance Sigma_x.

2. For any candidate model M subset of F with |M| factors, define F(M)t = {f_i,t: i in M} RHS and F_tilde(M)t = {f_i,t: i not in M} LHS plus optionally Rt. Run spanning regression F_tilde(M)t = alpha_tilde(M) + beta_tilde(M)' F(M)t + eps_tilde(M)t per Eq1.

3. Model comparison (non-nested): For any two models M1,M2 with |M1|=|M2| compare SR2{F(M1)} vs SR2{F(M2)} where SR2{x}= mu_x' Sigma_x^{-1} mu_x. Better model has larger SR2{F(M)} equivalently smaller misspecification SR2{F_tilde(M),F(M)} - SR2{F(M)} Eq BS_SR and smaller GRS(M)= (T-N)/(N-|M|) * ((1+SR2{F})/(1+SR2{F(M)}) -1) Eq GSR/GRS_j. In each FSE/BSE step j=1..J, compute GRS(M_j) and SR2{F(M_j)} for all J candidate models and select a_k = argmin_j GRS = argmax_j SR2 (forward add) or b_m = argmin_j GRS (backward remove).

4. Asset pricing test (stop criterion): Test H0: alpha_tilde(M)=0 vs H1 !=0. Use GRS F-test F(N-|M|, T-N) but low power when N-|M| large. Use HDA test Pesaran et al 2023: HDA(M)= [T alpha_hat' Diag(Sigma_eps_hat)^{-1} alpha_hat {1+SR2{F(M)}}^{-1} - N1]/ sqrt(2 N1 {1+(N1-1) rho_hat^2_NT}) -> N(0,1) under H0, N1=N-|M|. Reject if HDA > z_lambda where z_lambda is upper lambda quantile of N(0,1). Adopt lambda=0.05 primary (robustness 0.01,0.10).

5. FSE Algorithm (Algorithm1): Input F, baseline Mb. Initialize S(0)=Mb, tilde S(0)=F\Mb. For k=1 to N-|Mb|-1: for each j in tilde S(k-1) construct M_j(k-1)=S(k-1) U {j}, regress F_tilde(M_j) on F(M_j), compute GRS_j. Pick a_k = argmin GRS. Update S(k)=S(k-1)U{a_k}. Regress F_tilde(S(k)) on F(S(k)), compute HDA{S(k)}. If HDA<z_lambda stop; return Mb^F = S(k). Screening consistency Theorem1 requires z_lambda^1 <= T N^{-1/2 -n2} and |Mb^F|=O(N^{n1+2n2}) n1+2n2<1/3.

6. BSE Algorithm (Algorithm2): Input F, efficient Mb^F. Initialize S(0)=Mb^F. For m=1 to |Mb^F|-1: for each j in S(m-1) construct M_j(m-1)=S(m-1)\{j}, compute GRS_j. Pick b_m=argmin GRS (worst factor). Update S(m)=S(m-1)\{b_m}. Compute HDA{S(m)}. If HDA>z_lambda stop; return Mb^{F+B}=S(m-1). Selection consistency Theorem2 requires sqrt(N) log N <= z_lambda^2 <= T N^{-1/2 -n2}.

7. Toy illustration N=10 factors, baseline {f1}: step1 compare 9 expanded 2-factor models, pick min GRS/max SR2 e.g. f3, test HDA; iterative until non-rejection to obtain M^F={f1,f3,f6,f8,f7} example then BSE remove sequentially to M^{F+B}={f3,f7,f8}.

8. Empirical implementation: Apply FSE to each of 7 baseline models using LHS = unselected 97-|M| factors (and 285 portfolios optionally). Record GRS color bar and Ann.SR per step (Fig2, Fig3 FF3 example step1 REG min GRS 3.03 max SR 1.99, step2 PEAD GRS2.68 etc. until p>0.05). Then apply BSE to each expanded Mb^F to remove redundant (Fig4/Fig5 FF3^F removes HML then SIM then BAB until EPRD would reject at 5%). Obtain reduced M8 = {MKT, REG, PEAD, HMLM, STR, ILR, SMB, EPRD} identical across all baselines. Report asset pricing measures A|alpha|, A|t(alpha)|, #sign2 (|t|>1.96), Total R2 and CS R2 vs CAPM benchmark, and investment measures AVG%, Ann.SR, alpha_CAPM%, alpha_FF5% for mean-variance tangency portfolio weights = Sigma^{-1} mu.

9. OOS evaluation 3-fold: Split 588 months into 3 blocks Time1 1973/01-1989/04, Time2 1989/05-2005/08, Time3 2005/09-2021/12 each 196 months test, 392 train. In each fold train factor inclusion and compute weights, hold constant OOS, compute Total/CS R2 via INS betas/lambdas and Ann.SR OOS. Bootstrap model comparison: Form 294 month pairs (1,2)...(587,588), per bootstrap draw one of each pair as INS (294 months with replacement) and other as OOS, 1000 replications; compute INS SR2 and apply INS tangency weights to OOS to get OOS SR2; compute Prob(row beats col) = fraction runs where SR2_row > SR2_col and Prob(Best). Ridge regularization used in estimation.

10. Individual factor test: Baseline 2-factor MKT+row (96 models) and 4-factor FF3+row (94 models); run FSE expansion to efficiency then BSE pruning; count Selected (=row factor remains) and Same (=reduced equals M8) rates.
11. Alternative baselines: RP-PCA 5 factors from 285 portfolios, RRA 5 factors from 97 factors using 285 portfolios, LASSO FGX2020 (5 factors) and KNS2020 (7 factors); run same FSE/BSE.

12. Transaction cost robustness: Subtract from factor monthly returns 2 bps for annually rebalanced factors (SMB, EPRD, CMA etc. underlined) and 12 or 24 bps for monthly rebalanced (remaining); re-run stepwise; compare composition.

13. Simulation: Generate f1 ~ N(mu1,Sigma1) K1=5 FF5, f2 = beta' f1 + u, u~N(0,Sigma2). Baseline Case1: 1-factor f1(1); Case2: 2-factor f1(1)+f2(1) redundant. Run 1000 sims for each (K1,K2)=(5,20)/(5,100) T=3000/600 compare FSE/BSE(HDA) vs FSE/BSE(GRS) vs FSE/BSE(SR single-factor) compute |S_hat|, CP=P(S_hat superset T), CF=P(S_hat = T), TR=|S_hat cap T|/|T|, FR=|S_hat cap ~T|/|~T|.
14. Additional checks: 20 RP-PCA factors as test assets; sentiment split high if prior month S_PLS > median else low.
